checked_items.item: A-20 efficiency loss budget and plausibility estimate
checked_items.evidence: P_loss = 154.6 / 102.0 / 76.1 W for 97 / 98 / 98.5 %; 128.2 W at 97.5 %. Conduction 2 x 17.7^2 x 0.043 = 26.9 W cold, 43.1 W with the assumed 1.6 hot factor; switching (955 + 107) uJ x (400/800) x (25/40) x 50 kHz = 16.6 W (linear V and I scaling, standard first-order method; the body-diode E_on is the right case for a hard-switched synchronous buck); 85-95 W total -> 98.14-98.33 %. Arithmetic agrees; inputs are snippet-level and flagged as such. The selected device (mosfet.json, fetched datasheet C4MS025120K: E_on/E_off 470/64 uJ at 800 V / 39.2 A, E_rr 256 uJ, R_DS(on) 150 degC est. 48.5 mohm) gives lower switching loss (thermal agent: 28.7 W worst case per device), so the 97.5 % floor is conservative.

checked_items.item: A-18 thermal path limit P_max and 40 vs 50 degC sensitivity
checked_items.evidence: Formula (T_J - T_A)/(R_thJC + R_iso + 2 R_hs) is the correct two-devices-per-sink model (the sink carries 2P). checked_items.correction: Widen the pad range to 0.1-1.0 K/W, use the selected device's R_thJC = 0.41 K/W, restate P_max as about 39 W (margin 1.36 over 28.7 W per the thermal agent) and state that P_max is compared with the worse device of the pair (equal sharing is TI's assumption, SKILL-006 known limitation; with the sanity-device numbers HS about 38 W vs LS about 24 W, T_J,HS 116 degC).

knowledge_misuse: KR-CAP-002 is labelled 'direct' for the buck output capacitor although the rule's condition is 'DC links with high-frequency ripple'; the physics transfers, but the label should be 'adapted' so the trace shows the condition was extended.

KR-GD-008: the register says differential PWM/fault signalling 'applies directly' whenever drivers and controller are on separate boards. The rule's condition is cables or long traces and its exclusion is short links with buffered single-ended PWM; the architecture agent's option B (stacked 2.54 mm mezzanine, drivers on the power board) is a short link, so the condition should be stated in terms of link length and noise environment, not board count.

SKILL-006 known limitation (TI's model assumes equal sharing) is cited but not carried into Section 5: 'about 52 W per device ... exceeds the roughly 30 W per device expected' compares an equal-share limit with an average loss; P_max must be checked against the worse device of the pair, and the 52 W figure itself rests on a 0.1-0.5 K/W pad range that the thermal agent's selected 0.63-0.80 K/W pad falls outside.

A-24 attributes a 300 x 180 mm board size to REF-TI-TIDA-010054 decision 10; the knowledge record contains no board dimensions, so the citation does not support the number (unverified, not a copied instance value).
required_changes: Add a discharge assumption (new S/H row): input and output banks discharge to <= 60 V within 60 s by passive bleeders with a warning label, or within 5 s where terminals are accessible (IEC 61800-5-1 4.3.11, as selected by the standards agent); give the sizing method R <= t / (C ln(V0 / 60)) and the loss (about 0.3 W input, 0.1 W output for 60 s) so the capacitor and efficiency budgets include it.

Add an input DC-link ripple-voltage target to Section 4.1 (e.g. <= 2 % pk-pk = 8 Vpp at 400 V, matching the capacitor agent's A1) with dQ = D(1-D) Io / fs = 125 / 138 uC -> C >= 17 uF (34 uF for 1 %), so KR-CAP-001 has its dV_allowed from the register rather than from the capacitor agent.

Extend A-11 with the full load-dump case 25 A (and 27.5 A) -> 0: LI^2 minimum C = 40.7 uF for +10 V, +4.1 V at 100 uF; the capacitor agent's 14.8 V excursion at f_c = 2.5 kHz exceeds +/-5 %; state whether the dump may trip output OVP or must stay below it, and set the recovery time for this case.

Add an output OVP threshold row (the sensing agent uses 220 V = +10 %; keep >= 10 V above the allowed transient excursion and below the 1.25 x 200 V divider full scale) and an input OVP response-time expectation for the 440 -> 480 V transient.

Resolve the A-02 / A-05 inconsistency: at the 320 V UVLO stop and 27.5 A the input current is 17.5 A (16.5 A at 340 V), above the 16 A minimum source limit; either raise the A-05 lower bound to >= 18 A or add an input-power derating / input-current limit below 360 V to A-02 and the firmware contract A-34.

A-18 / Section 5: widen the parametric pad resistance to 0.1-1.0 K/W, use R_thJC = 0.41 K/W of the selected C4MS025120K and the thermal agent's 0.68 K/W sink: P_max = (150 - 50)/(0.41 + 0.80 + 2 x 0.68) = 38.9 W (margin 1.36 over 28.7 W), replacing 'about 52 W per device'; state that the limit is checked on the worse device and that equal sharing is TI's assumption.

Add a switch-node overshoot allowance (S) for the device-class evaluation and the commutation-loop target, e.g. <= 90 V above Vin (<= 530 Vpk at 440 V, consistent with the MOSFET agent's 502 / 528 Vpk and the standards agent's 530 Vpk recurring peak), so 'before switching overshoot' in A-04 becomes a number.

Correct the inrush charge-time range: 1.6-4.8 ms at 5 A and 0.53-1.6 ms at 15 A (20-60 uF, 400 V); replace '1.07-4.8 ms at 5 A' and the markdown '1.1-4.8 ms' with 0.5-4.8 ms over the 5-15 A limit range.
A-09: state the ripple limits as one budget (both at their limits give 4.0 Vpp): e.g. C >= 20 uF and ESR <= 0.12 ohm, or note that the realised 108 uF film bank (0.25 Vpp) makes the split irrelevant.

A-19 / A-22: budget the fan at its maximum rated current, not the typical value (AFB0812SH: 0.34 A typical, 0.51 A maximum per distributor listing), and note that the 2 m/s figure needs the fan curve against the heat-sink impedance; the thermal agent's integrated fan (0.3 A) must be verified against the same cap.

A-30: mark the Isola 370HR CTI class 3 as unverified until read from the full data sheet or the UL E41625 record (Tg 180 / Td 340 / V-0 / E41625 are confirmed); the material group IIIa creepage values depend on it.
A-24: replace or source the 'TIDA-010054 300 x 180 mm' benchmark (not present in the cited knowledge record); keep V1 300 x 220 mm, which is verified.

Replace the C3M0032120K snippet values in A-18 / A-20 and the 'no Wolfspeed R_thJC verified' open issue with the selected device's fetched-datasheet values from mosfet.json (C4MS025120K: R_thJC 0.41 K/W, Q_G 125 nC, R_DS(on) 28 mohm typ / 48.5 mohm at 150 degC est., V_SD 4.6 V hot, E_on/E_off 470/64 uJ, E_rr 256 uJ at 800 V / 39.2 A).

Relabel KR-CAP-002 (output capacitor) as 'adapted' and rewrite the KR-GD-008 condition in A-21 in terms of link length / noise environment (mezzanine = short link, rule exclusion) rather than board count.
Section 5: add the HS/LS loss split statement for the shared-sink check (sanity numbers HS about 38 W, LS about 24 W; selected device 51/49 % per the thermal agent).

Tooling note: the UnicodeEncodeError depends on the console code page (gbk on this host, cp1252 on the agent's); recommend that query.py reconfigure stdout to UTF-8 or use ensure_ascii so the workaround is not needed.
summary: All twenty calculations in the register reproduce from the stated inputs (operating points at six corners, saturation requirement 41.07 A -> 42 A, ripple and transient capacitance, efficiency budget, thermal P_max sensitivity, UVLO/OVP ladder, dead time, gate power, auxiliary budget, fan velocity); the only arithmetic slip is the inrush charge-time range (1.07 ms belongs to 40 uF / 15 A). Knowledge rules were applied inside their conditions, the KR-GD-005 buck exclusion conflict was preserved and handed to the gate-driver agent, human-review rules were surfaced not decided, and no reference instance values were copied; query top hits reproduce exactly. The register is nevertheless incomplete and in two places inconsistent: it omits a DC-link discharge requirement, an input ripple target, the full load-dump case, an output OVP level and a switch-node overshoot allowance (quantities the capacitor, standards and sensing agents then had to invent); the UVLO stop (320 V) allows 17.5 A input current against a 16 A minimum source limit; and the thermal conclusion 'about 52 W per device' rests on a 0.1-0.5 K/W pad range that the selected interface (0.63-0.80 K/W) falls outside - the limit is 38.9 W with the selected parts. The Isola 370HR CTI class (material group IIIa) and the TIDA-010054 300 x 180 mm benchmark could not be verified. Verdict: confirmed with the listed corrections.
